name: dsh-suez-office
description: DSH-SUEZ-Office: the Office toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (Windows, no Python). Creates and edits PowerPoint / Word / Excel / PDF on this machine: brand-compliant .pptx seeded from the official SUEZ template (masters, layouts, theme and embedded fonts preserved, 29 page archetypes, 13 native charts), free-form hand-laid decks, .docx and .xlsx from a JSON spec, surgical edits to files users already have (text, pictures, chart values, table cells, cells with formulas), comments and tracked-change cleanup, PDF export, plus structure dump, package gates and geometric lint with real Office rendering for QA.
author: Rio Zhao
